# AGENTS.md

Instructions for AI agents (and humans) working in this repository.

**Wallshift** (`wallshift@inklikeurine`) is one Cinnamon panel applet, generated by AI under
human direction. This repository is the applet and nothing else: its root is
laid out exactly like a [Cinnamon Spices](https://github.com/linuxmint/cinnamon-spices-applets)
`<uuid>/` folder, plus these repo files.

## The workshop

The rules, the validator, the test harness, this applet's tests and its
verification journal live in a **private workshop** next to this repo:
`../_workshop/` (`inklikeurine/cinnamon-workshop`), shared by every applet
in `~/src/cinnamon/`. Read its rules before changing anything:

@../_workshop/AGENTS.md

Commands are run from this repo's folder, e.g.
`python3 ../_workshop/tools/check.py --uuid wallshift@inklikeurine`. The Claude Code hook
in `.claude/settings.json` runs the validator after every edit and skips
quietly when the workshop is absent.

## Without the workshop

On a clone without `../_workshop/`, the essentials still apply, done by hand:

- The repo root holds only `info.json`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`,
  `screenshot.png`, `files/wallshift@inklikeurine/` and the repo files (`AGENTS.md`,
  `CLAUDE.md`, `UNLICENSE`, `.gitignore`, `.claude/settings.json`).
- Every functional change under `files/wallshift@inklikeurine/` bumps `version` in
  `metadata.json` (semver) and adds a dated `CHANGELOG.md` entry.
- Files headed `// @shared` are vendored copies: never edit them.
- No `package.json`, linter config or CI. Unlicense only, no file headers.
- Never claim the applet was tested on the desktop; only a human ticks
  Manual Review.
